option.en: Hello kids! Today, let’s learn about the wonderful life cycle of a butterfly.

option.en: A butterfly starts its life as a very tiny egg. It’s so small that you might need to look very carefully to see it. Just like a little surprise waiting to hatch.

option.en: Then, from the egg comes a caterpillar. The caterpillar is hungry all the time and it eats a lot of leaves. It grows bigger and bigger. Sometimes, the caterpillar even molts its skin because it’s growing so fast. For example, a Monarch caterpillar has stripes and can be quite colorful.

option.en: Finally, a beautiful butterfly emerges from the cocoon. It spreads its wings and is ready to fly. The butterfly has bright colors and patterns on its wings. It can fly from flower to flower, drinking nectar. Just like a little fairy in the garden.

option.en: Dragon fruit, we also call it pitaya.
option.cn: 火龙果,我们也叫它“pitaya”｡

option.en: The dragon fruit has a bright and colorful appearance.
option.cn: 火龙果有着明亮且多彩的外观｡

option.en: The most common ones are the red-skinned pitayas.
option.cn: 最常见的是红皮火龙果｡

option.en: The inside of the red-skinned dragon fruit usually has white or red flesh.
option.cn: 红皮火龙果的内部通常有白色或红色的果肉｡

option.en: The white flesh is tender and juicy, while the red flesh is even more vibrant and sweet.
option.cn: 白色的果肉鲜嫩多汁,而红色的果肉则更加鲜艳且甜美｡

option.en: There is also a kind of yellow-skinned dragon fruit.
option.cn: 也有一种黄皮火龙果｡

option.en: Its skin is yellow and very eye-catching. The flesh inside is usually white.
option.cn: 它的皮是黄色的,非常引人注目｡里面的果肉通常是白色的｡

option.en: We can eat dragon fruits directly or make them into juice.
option.cn: 我们可以直接吃火龙果,也可以把它们做成果汁｡

option.en: Today, let’s talk about the raisin.
option.cn: 今天,让我们来谈谈葡萄干｡

option.en: This is a bunch of selected seedless grapes.
option.cn: 这是一串精选的无籽葡萄｡

option.en: Spread the grapes on the drying tray in the sun to dry out the water.
option.cn: 把葡萄铺在晾晒盘上在太阳下晾晒以除去水分｡

option.en: Then, hang the grapes in the drying room, and keep ventilated and air-dried.
option.cn: 然后,把葡萄挂在干燥室里,并保持通风和风干｡

option.en: It may take about 55 days.
option.cn: 这可能需要大约55天｡

option.en: Take out the grapes, stack and keep for 2 to 3 weeks.
option.cn: 取出葡萄,堆积并保存2到3周｡

option.en: Finally remove the stalks, we get the raisins.
option.cn: 最后去掉茎梗,我们就得到了葡萄干｡

option.en: We can eat raisins as a delicious snack.
option.cn: 我们可以把葡萄干当作美味的零食来吃｡

option.en: They are sweet and full of flavor.
option.cn: 它们很甜且充满风味｡

option.en: We can also put them in cakes, cookies, or even add them to our cereal.
option.cn: 我们也可以把它们放到蛋糕、饼干里,甚至加到我们的麦片里｡

option.en: This is a tangerine. It’s a kind of citrus fruit.
option.cn: 这是一个橘子｡它是柑橘类水果的一种｡

option.en: Tangerines grow on trees.
option.cn: 橘子长在树上｡

option.en: They are usually small and cute, and their color is bright orange.
option.cn: 它们通常又小又可爱,颜色是亮橙色｡

option.en: Tangerines are easier to peel than oranges.
option.cn: 橘子比橙子更容易剥皮｡

option.en: They are juicy and sweet.
option.cn: 它们多汁又香甜｡

option.en: When eating tangerines, don’t forget to spit out the seeds if you find them.
option.cn: 吃橘子的时候,如果发现有籽,别忘了吐出来｡

option.en: A grapefruit is a big and round fruit.
option.cn: 柚子是一种又大又圆的水果｡

option.en: It has a thick rind that can be yellow.
option.cn: 它有一层厚厚的果皮,可能是黄色的｡

option.en: When you cut it open, you’ll see juicy segments inside.
option.cn: 当你把它切开时,你会看到里面多汁的瓣｡

option.en: You can remove the rind with your fingers.
option.cn: 你可以用手指去掉果皮｡

option.en: Break apart the fruit, and peel the skin.
option.cn: 把水果掰开,然后剥掉果皮｡

option.en: Take a bite. It is both sweet and a little bit sour.
option.cn: 咬一口｡它既甜又有点酸｡

option.en: Coconuts grow on tall coconut trees in tropical regions.
option.cn: 椰子生长在热带地区高高的椰子树上｡

option.en: A coconut is a big and round fruit.
option.cn: 椰子是一种又大又圆的水果｡

option.en: It has a hard, brown shell on the outside.
option.cn: 它的外面有一层坚硬的棕色外壳｡

option.en: When you crack open the shell, you’ll find a white layer of flesh inside.
option.cn: 当你敲开外壳,你会发现里面有一层白色的果肉｡

option.en: This flesh is sweet and has a nice flavor. You can eat it.
option.cn: 这种果肉很甜,味道很好｡你可以生吃｡

option.en: There’s also a clear liquid inside the coconut called coconut water. It’s really nice and sweet.
option.cn: 椰子里面还有一种清澈的液体,叫做椰子水｡它真的非常好喝,很甜｡

option.en: The papaya is a tropical fruit.
option.cn: 木瓜是一种热带水果｡

option.en: Papayas grow on papaya trees.
option.cn: 木瓜长在木瓜树上｡

option.en: They are usually big and oval in shape.
option.cn: 它们通常呈大的椭圆形｡

option.en: The outside of a papaya is usually yellow or green when it’s ripe.
option.cn: 木瓜成熟时,其外皮通常是黄色或绿色｡

option.en: When you cut open a papaya, you’ll see the inside is full of small black seeds in the center.
option.cn: 当你切开一个木瓜,你会看到里面的中心部位充满了黑色的小籽｡

option.en: The flesh of the papaya is soft and sweet.
option.cn: 木瓜的果肉柔软且香甜｡

option.en: The star fruit looks like a star when you cut it across.
option.cn: 当你把杨桃横着切开时,它看起来像一颗星星｡

option.en: That’s why it’s called the star fruit.
option.cn: 这就是它被称为杨桃的原因｡

option.en: The color of the star fruit is usually yellow or green.
option.cn: 杨桃的颜色通常是黄色或绿色｡

option.en: It has a smooth and shiny skin.
option.cn: 它有光滑且有光泽的表皮｡

option.en: Take a bite, it’s juicy and sweet. Maybe a little sour too.
option.cn: 咬一口,它多汁又甜｡可能也有点酸｡

option.en: You can eat it fresh just like that. Or put it in a fruit salad.
option.cn: 你可以就这样新鲜地吃｡或者把它放进水果沙拉里｡

option.en: The lime is a small and green fruit.
option.cn: 酸橙是一种小且绿色的水果｡

option.en: If you smell it, it has a very fresh and strong smell.
option.cn: 如果你闻它,它有非常清新且强烈的气味｡

option.en: The lime is very sour.
option.cn: 酸橙非常酸｡

option.en: We can add some lime juice to water to make limeade.
option.cn: 我们可以往水里加一些酸橙汁来制作酸橙汁汽水｡

option.en: It’s very refreshing on a hot day.
option.cn: 在炎热的日子里它非常清爽｡

option.en: We can also use lime juice when we cook fish or make salad.
option.cn: 我们在做鱼或者做沙拉时也可以用酸橙汁｡

option.en: Mangosteens grow on trees in warm places.
option.cn: 山竹生长在温暖地区的树上｡

option.en: Sometimes, you might see them in the market or at the store.
option.cn: 有时,你可能会在市场或商店里看到它们｡

option.en: The mangosteen is a small, round fruit.
option.cn: 山竹是一种小而圆的水果｡

option.en: It has a thick, purple shell.
option.cn: 它有一个厚厚的、紫色的外壳｡

option.en: When you open it up, there are white segments that look like little petals.
option.cn: 当你打开它时,里面有白色的瓣状物,看起来像小花瓣｡

option.en: These segments are soft and sweet.
option.cn: 这些瓣状物柔软且甜美｡

option.cn: 胡萝卜生长在地下｡

option.en: A carrot is a long, orange vegetable.
option.cn: 胡萝卜是一种长长的、橙色的蔬菜｡

option.en: Carrots can help you see better at night.
option.cn: 胡萝卜能帮助你在晚上看得更清楚｡

option.en: Because they have vitamin A in them.
option.cn: 因为它们里面含有维生素A｡

option.en: You can eat carrots raw. They are crunchy and sweet.
option.cn: 你可以生吃胡萝卜｡它们脆甜可口｡

option.en: Sometimes, they are cut into small pieces and added to soups or stews.
option.cn: 有时,它们会被切成小块加到汤或炖菜里｡

option.en: This is a fire engine, we also call it fire truck.
option.cn: 这是一辆消防车,我们也可以叫“fire truck”｡

option.en: This is a firefighter, who helps keep people safe.
option.cn: 这是一名消防员,他帮助保障人们的安全｡

option.en: Look at the ladder, it can help firefighters climb very high.
option.cn: 看那个梯子,它可以帮助消防员爬的很高｡

option.en: The fire truck has a hose that can spray water very far.
option.cn: 消防车有一根能把水喷得很远的水管｡

option.cn: 消防车是一种用于灭火的卡车｡

option.en: Firefighters wear special suits to protect themselves.
option.cn: 消防员们穿着特殊的制服来保护他们自己｡

option.en: The fire engine has a big water tank to put out fires.
option.cn: 消防车有一个大的水箱来灭火｡

option.en: Look at the axe, firefighters use the axe to break down doors.
option.cn: 看看那把斧头,消防员用那把斧头来破门｡

option.cn: 救护车是一种非常特别的车辆｡

option.cn: 救护车通常是白色带有红色条纹,顶部有大大的闪烁灯｡

option.en: When it is on an emergency call, the lights flash and the siren makes a loud noise.
option.cn: 当它接到紧急呼叫时,灯光闪烁且警笛发出响亮的声音｡

option.en: Ambulances rush to the scene of accidents or where people are sick very quickly.
option.cn: 救护车会非常迅速地赶到事故现场或病人所在的地方｡

option.en: It is designed to help people who are sick or injured.
option.cn: 它被设计用来帮助生病或受伤的人｡

option.en: Inside the ambulance, there are many important things, like stretchers, bandages and first aid kits.
option.cn: 在救护车内部,有许多重要的东西,比如担架、绷带和急救箱｡

option.en: The noise let everyone know it is coming through in a hurry.
option.cn: 响亮的声音让每个人都知道它正在驶来｡

option.en: They are like heroes on wheels, racing to help those in need.
option.cn: 它们就像轮子上的英雄,竞相去帮助那些有需要的人｡

option.en: The police car is a motor vehicle used by police.
option.cn: 警车是警察使用的一种机动车｡

option.en: The police will drive the police cars to patrol the streets to keep us safe.
option.cn: 警察将驾驶警车在街道上巡逻以保障我们的安全｡

option.en: The police car has flashing lights that blink very brightly.
option.cn: 警车有非常明亮闪烁的闪光灯｡

option.en: It also has a loud siren that can be heard from far away.
option.cn: 它也有一个响亮的警报器,从很远的地方都能听到｡

option.en: Sometimes you might see a police car driving by on the street.
option.cn: 有时你可能会看到一辆警车在街上驶过｡

option.en: It might be on its way to help someone or to keep the peace.
option.cn: 它可能正在去帮助某人或维护和平的路上｡

option.en: The police officers inside are working hard to protect us all.
option.cn: 里面的警察们正在努力工作以保护我们所有人｡

option.en: Remember, the police car is our friend. It helps to make our world a safer place.
option.cn: 记住,警车是我们的朋友｡它有助于让我们的世界成为一个更安全的地方｡

option.en: This is an excavator, we also call it digger.
option.cn: 这是一台挖掘机,我们也叫它“digger”｡

option.en: This part looks like a big spoon and with teeth, it is called a bucket.
option.cn: 这部分看起来像一个带齿的大勺子,它被叫做铲斗｡

option.en: This is called the cab, the workers can sit in it and operate the excavator.
option.cn: 这被称为驾驶室,工人们可以坐在里面操作挖掘机｡

option.en: The two oval belts at the bottom are called tracks.
option.cn: 底部的这两条椭圆形的带子被称为履带｡

option.en: There is a long arm in front of it, we call it boom.
option.cn: 在它前面有一个长长的臂,我们称它为起重臂｡

option.en: It can help us shovel away dirt and stones.
option.cn: 它可以帮助我们铲走泥土和石头｡

option.en: This is the engine, it helps to bring power to the excavator.
option.cn: 这是发动机,它有助于给挖掘机带来动力｡

option.en: The excavator can move backwards and forwards on its tracks.
option.cn: 挖掘机可以依靠它的履带前后移动｡

option.en: This is a wheel loader. It is very strong.
option.cn: 这是一台轮式装载机｡它非常强壮｡

option.en: It has a very big bucket used to carry heavy objects.
option.cn: 它有一个非常大的用来搬运重物的铲斗｡

option.en: The worker operates a wheel loader in the cab.
option.cn: 工人在驾驶室内操作轮式装载机｡

option.en: They can be used to pick up heavy objects that don’t fit in the bucket.
option.cn: 它们可以被用来搬起那些不适合放在铲斗里的重物｡

option.en: It moves by four big wheels.
option.cn: 它通过四个大轮子移动｡

option.en: Wheel loaders can pick up very heavy stones and dump them into a dump truck.
option.cn: 轮式装载机能够铲起非常重的石头并将它们倾倒进自卸卡车里｡

option.en: Some wheel loaders can switch out their bucket for two big forks.
option.cn: 一些轮式装载机可以把它们的铲斗换成两个大叉子｡

option.en: Wheel loaders are very helpful at the construction sites.
option.cn: 轮式装载机在建筑工地上非常有帮助｡

option.en: This is a bulldozer.
option.cn: 这是一辆推土机｡

option.en: The bulldozer has a very big blade attached to its front.
option.cn: 推土机有一个非常大的推土铲安装在它的前端｡

option.en: It is perfect for building roads, farms and buildings.
option.cn: 它非常适合修筑道路、农场和建筑物｡

option.en: The bulldozer can even push hard soil and dirt easily.
option.cn: 推土机甚至可以轻松地推硬土和泥土｡

option.en: It has two big tracks that allow it to move forward and backward.
option.cn: 它有两条大履带,这使得它能够向前和向后移动｡

option.en: A bulldozer is used to flatten the ground.
option.cn: 推土机被用来平整地面｡

option.en: The driver of the bulldozer sits in a cab with large windows.
option.cn: 推土机的司机坐在带有大窗户的驾驶室里｡

option.en: It is very strong and heavy.
option.cn: 它非常强壮且沉重｡

option.en: This is a road roller.
option.cn: 这是一台压路机｡

option.en: This road roller has one big rolling drum.
option.cn: 这台压路机有一个大的碾压轮｡

option.en: The driver sits inside the cab and operates the road roller.
option.cn: 司机坐在驾驶室内操作压路机｡

option.en: It helps to build nice and smooth roads for us to walk and drive on.
option.cn: 它有助于为我们建造漂亮且平坦的道路以便我们行走和驾驶｡

option.en: Road roller is used to firm up the ground.
option.cn: 压路机被用来加固地面｡

option.en: When it rolls over the ground, it makes the ground very smooth and firm.
option.cn: 当它在地面上滚动时,它会使地面变得非常光滑和坚固｡

option.en: The road roller can move forward and backward very slowly.
option.cn: 压路机能够非常缓慢地向前和向后移动｡

option.en: The road roller plays a very important role in road building.
option.cn: 压路机在道路建设中起着非常重要的作用｡

option.en: This is a cement mixer.
option.cn: 这是一台水泥搅拌车｡

option.en: Cement mixer is used to deliver some wet cement.
option.cn: 水泥搅拌机被用来运送一些湿水泥｡

option.en: There is a large drum on the back of the cement mixer truck.
option.cn: 在水泥搅拌车的背部有一个非常大的滚筒｡

option.en: The part in front of the drum is the water tank.
option.cn: 滚筒前面的部分是水箱｡

option.en: The wet cement is poured onto the delivery site from the chute.
option.cn: 湿水泥从斜槽被倾倒到交付地点｡

option.en: It needs to spin to mix the wet cement.
option.cn: 它需要旋转来搅拌湿水泥｡

option.en: It holds water to keep the cement wet.
option.cn: 它装水来保持水泥是湿的｡

option.en: Cement mixers are very helpful in building roads, houses and buildings.
option.cn: 水泥搅拌机在修建道路、房屋和建筑物方面非常有帮助｡

option.en: This is a dump truck.
option.cn: 这是一辆翻斗车｡

option.en: It is used to carry very heavy loads and then dump them out.
option.cn: 它被用于运载非常重的货物然后将它们倾倒出去｡

option.en: It can carry anything, like rocks, sand or dirt.
option.cn: 它可以运载任何东西,比如石头、沙子或泥土｡

option.en: This is the hydraulic ram.
option.cn: 这是液压柱塞｡

option.en: When the hydraulic ram lifts the truck bed, the dirt will be dumped out.
option.cn: 当液压柱塞抬起卡车车斗时,泥土将会被倾卸出去｡

option.en: This is the cab where the driver sits.
option.cn: 这是驾驶员所坐的驾驶室｡

option.en: The dump truck is good for cleaning up a construction site.
option.cn: 翻斗车有利于清理一个建筑工地｡

option.en: It is also helpful in moving materials.
option.cn: 它在搬运材料方面也很有帮助｡

option.en: This is a garbage truck.
option.cn: 这是一辆垃圾车｡

option.en: It has a large container on the back to hold all the garbage.
option.cn: 它在后面有一个大容器来装所有的垃圾｡

option.en: The driver of the garbage truck is very hardworking.
option.cn: 垃圾车的司机非常勤劳｡

option.en: The garbage truck takes away all the dirty and smelly garbage.
option.cn: 垃圾车带走所有又脏又臭的垃圾｡

option.en: It is designed to collect and transport garbage.
option.cn: 它被设计用于收集和运输垃圾｡

option.en: The garbage truck drives around the city to pick up the garbage from different places.
option.cn: 垃圾车在城市里到处行驶,从不同的地方收集垃圾｡

option.en: They have to get up early in the morning and drive around to collect all the garbage.
option.cn: 他们必须在清晨起床并四处行驶去收集所有垃圾｡

option.en: It is very important to keep our environment clean.
option.cn: 它对于保持我们的环境干净是非常重要的｡

option.en: This is a sprinkler truck.
option.cn: 这是一辆洒水车｡

option.en: The tank is filled with water.
option.cn: 水箱装满了水｡

option.en: When the weather is dry and the road is dusty, the sprinkler truck comes out to work.
option.cn: 当天气干燥且道路布满灰尘时,洒水车就会出来工作｡

option.en: It’s like a big cleaning machine for the road.
option.cn: 它就像道路的一个大型清洁机器｡

option.en: It looks very big, and has a tank on it.
option.cn: 它看起来非常大,上面有一个水箱｡

option.en: The sprinkler truck drives on the road and can spray water out through its special pipes.
option.cn: 洒水车在路上行驶,可以通过其特殊的管道将水喷出｡

option.en: It sprays water onto the road to make the dust settle down and keep the air clean.
option.cn: 它将水喷洒到道路上,使灰尘沉降并保持空气清洁｡

option.en: The sprinkler truck is an important vehicle that helps to make our city more beautiful and clean.
option.cn: 洒水车是帮助使我们的城市更加美丽和干净的重要车辆｡

option.en: This is a sweeper truck.
option.cn: 这是一辆扫地车｡

option.en: It has big brushes on the bottom that spin very fast.
option.cn: 它底部有很大的刷子,能快速旋转｡

option.en: It’s like a big cleaning machine on wheels!
option.cn: 它就像一个带轮子的大型清洁机器!

option.en: The sweeper truck is very important because it helps keep our streets clean.
option.cn: 扫地车非常重要,因为它有助于保持我们的街道清洁｡

option.en: It is designed to clean the roads.
option.cn: 它被设计用于清扫道路｡

option.en: When the sweeper truck drives, the brushes move and sweep up dirt, leaves and trash.
option.cn: 当扫地车沿着道路行驶时,那些刷子转动并清扫所有的灰尘、树叶和垃圾｡

option.en: They make a funny noise as they work.
option.cn: 它们工作时会发出一种有趣的噪音｡

option.en: So, if you see a sweeper truck next time, give it a little wave!
option.cn: 所以,如果你下次看到一辆扫地车,就向它挥挥手!

option.en: The ice cream truck is not a normal vehicle.
option.cn: 冰淇淋车不是一辆普通的车辆｡

option.en: It is a special vehicle with delicious ice creams.
option.cn: 它是一辆装有美味冰淇淋的特殊车辆｡

option.en: It’s usually colorful and has pictures of delicious ice creams on it.
option.cn: 它通常色彩鲜艳,上面有美味冰淇淋的图片｡

option.en: The ice cream truck has many kinds of ice creams, such as chocolate, vanilla, strawberry, mango and so on.
option.cn: 这辆冰淇淋车有很多种冰淇淋,比如巧克力味的、香草味的、草莓味的、芒果味的等等｡

option.en: Choose your favorite flavor and share with your mum.

option.en: It makes you feel cool and happy in the hot day.

option.en: An airplane is like a big bird that can fly high up in the sky.
option.cn: 飞机就像一只可以在高空飞翔的大鸟｡

option.en: Airplanes can take us to faraway places quickly.
option.cn: 飞机能很快地把我们带到遥远的地方｡

option.en: An airplane has a long body called the fuselage.
option.cn: 飞机有一个长长的机身,叫做机身｡

option.en: An airplane has big wings that help it fly in the sky.
option.cn: 飞机有大翅膀帮助它在空中飞行｡

option.en: The cockpit is where the pilot drives the airplane.
option.cn: 驾驶舱是飞行员驾驶飞机的地方｡

option.en: The engines make the airplane go very fast.

option.en: The high-speed train
option.cn: 高铁

option.en: Dear kids, let me tell you about high-speed trains.
option.cn: 亲爱的孩子们,让我给你们讲讲高铁｡

option.en: A high-speed train is a very fast and cool vehicle. It looks like a long snake. It can run very quickly on special tracks.
option.cn: 高铁是一种速度非常快而且很酷的交通工具｡它看起来像一条长长的蛇｡它能在特殊的轨道上跑得非常快｡

option.en: The inside of a high-speed train is nice and comfortable. There are many seats for people to sit. There are also big windows so you can see the beautiful views outside.
option.cn: 高铁内部漂亮又舒适｡有很多座位供人们乘坐｡还有大窗户,这样你们就能看到外面美丽的景色｡

option.en: High-speed trains can take us to different cities in a short time.
option.cn: 高铁能在短时间内把我们带到不同的城市｡

option.en: It makes our trips more fun and easier. Isn’t it amazing?
option.cn: 它让我们的旅行更有趣更轻松｡难道不神奇吗?

option.en: A bus is a big vehicle that can carry many people. It has big wheels and a long body.
option.cn: 公交车是一种大型交通工具,可以搭载很多人｡它有大轮子和长长的车身｡

option.en: You can often see buses on the road.
option.cn: 你经常能在路上看到公交车｡

option.en: The driver sits in the cab. He controls the bus to keep us safe.
option.cn: 司机坐在驾驶室里｡他控制公交车以保障我们的安全｡

option.en: The wheels help the bus move and roll along the road.
option.cn: 轮子帮助公交车移动,并沿着道路滚动｡

option.en: The seats are for us to sit on. So, we can have a rest during the trip.
option.cn: 座位是供我们乘坐的｡所以,我们在旅途中可以休息｡

option.en: We get on the bus from the front door.
option.cn: 我们从前门上车｡

option.en: We get off the bus from the back door.
option.cn: 我们从后门下车｡

option.en: The windows let in light and we can see outside.
option.cn: 窗户透光,我们可以看到外面｡

option.en: A car is a vehicle that can take us to different places quickly and easily.
option.cn: 汽车是一种能够快速且轻松地带我们去不同地方的交通工具｡

option.en: Let’s get to know the main parts of a car today!
option.cn: 今天让我们来了解一下汽车的主要部件!

option.en: Wheel: The wheels help the car move forward and turn. They are like the feet of the car.
option.cn: 车轮:车轮帮助汽车向前移动和转弯｡它们就像汽车的脚｡

option.en: Steering wheel: The steering wheel is what the driver uses to control where the car goes.
option.cn: 方向盘:方向盘是司机用来控制汽车行驶方向的｡

option.en: Engine: The engine is like the heart of the car. It gives the power to make the car go.
option.cn: 发动机:发动机就像汽车的心脏｡它提供让汽车行驶的动力｡

option.en: Brake: The brakes help the car stop when we need it to.
option.cn: 刹车:刹车在我们需要时帮助汽车停下来｡

option.en: Seat: Seats are where we sit. They keep us comfortable during the ride.
option.cn: 座椅:座椅是我们乘坐时坐的地方｡它们让我们在行程中保持舒适｡

option.en: License plate: The license plate is like its special name that helps us know which car it is.
option.cn: 车牌:车牌就像它的特殊名字,帮助我们知道是哪辆车｡

option.en: Rotor blade: They spin very fast to make the helicopter fly.
option.cn: 旋翼叶片:它们快速旋转以使直升机飞行｡

option.en: Cockpit: The pilot sits and controls the helicopter in the cockpit.
option.cn: 驾驶舱:飞行员坐在驾驶舱内控制直升机｡

option.en: Tail rotor: It helps the helicopter to turn and stay balanced.
option.cn: 尾桨:它帮助直升机转弯并保持平衡｡

option.en: Wheels or Skids: They help the helicopter land safely.
option.cn: 轮子或滑橇:它们帮助直升机安全着陆｡

option.en: They can help rescue people in danger.
option.cn: 它们可以帮助救援处于危险中的人｡

option.en: For example, if someone is lost in a mountain or hurt in an accident, a helicopter can quickly fly there and save them.
option.cn: 例如,如果有人在山上迷路或在事故中受伤,直升机可以迅速飞到那里并拯救他们｡

option.en: They can also be used to put out fires.
option.cn: 它们还可以用于灭火｡

option.en: Firefighters can fly in a helicopter to reach the fire and pour water to put it out.
option.cn: 消防员可以乘坐直升机到达火灾现场并倒水灭火｡

option.en: Helicopters have many uses.
option.cn: 直升机有许多用途｡
